[***Population Studies***]{.journal} · 2024

\[[Article](https://doi.org/10.1080/00324728.2024.2332629)\] · \[[Replication kit](https://figshare.com/s/8b810e093fc32bcbe890)\]

> *We document and provide tools for the practical implementation of a regression-based method for redistributing misclassified causes of death proposed by Sully Ledermann. We refine the method through elaborating on its mathematical properties and evaluating performance through simulations.*
